meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
₹3000 ke andar **running shoes lena possible hai**, aur agar aap **daily jogging / beginner running** ke liye le rahe hain to main pehle **Nike Run Defy**, **Puma Voltaic Evo**, aur **Skechers Go Run Consistent** ko shortlist karne ki salah dunga.[2][12]

- **Best overall:** **Nike Run Defy** — lightweight build, soft foam cushioning, aur daily use + running ke liye balanced option ke roop mein recommend kiya gaya hai.[2][12]
- **Best cushioning:** **Skechers Go Run Consistent** — ultra-light foam aur M-Strike technology ke saath, beginners aur heel-strikers ke liye comfortable pick bataya gaya hai.[2]
- **Best pure running focus:** **Puma Voltaic Evo** — running performance ke liye stronger choice ke roop mein cite kiya gaya hai.[12]
- **Trusted budget alternatives:** **ASICS Jolt 5 / Patriot 13**, **Adidas Duramo SL / Duramo SL 2**, aur **Nike Revolution 8 / Downshifter 14** bhi ₹3000 ke andar beginner-friendly options ke roop mein mention hue hain.[1]

Agar aapko **sirf 1 shoe** lena hai, to ye simple rule follow karein:

- **Mostly running karni hai:** **Puma Voltaic Evo** ya **Nike Run Defy**.[2][12]
- **Comfort/cushioning zyada chahiye:** **Skechers Go Run Consistent**.[2]
- **Brand + all-round daily use chahiye:** **Nike Run Defy**.[2][12]
- **Sale mein value chahiye:** **ASICS Duramo/Duramo SL 2** ya **Nike Downshifter 14** ke discounted deals dekhna chahiye.[1]

Kharidte waqt in 4 cheezon par dhyan dein:

- **Fit**: toe box mein thoda space ho, par heel slip na ho.
- **Cushioning**: agar aap 3–5 km daily run karte hain, to soft foam/cushioning useful hoti hai.[1][2]
- **Outsole grip**: Indian roads aur wet surface ke liye rubber outsole better hota hai.[2]
- **Sale price**: kai models MRP par ₹3000 ke upar hote hain, lekin sale mein ₹2000–₹3000 range mein aa jaate hain.[1]

Agar aap chahein, main aapke liye **men/women**, **running only vs walking+running**, aur **road vs treadmill** ke hisaab se *top 3 exact picks* bhi shortlist kar sakta hoon.
